title: Haapsalu Castle
identityStatus: Exact castle identity node with independently named/matched cathedral, museum and enclosure; no exact-QID area resolved.

church.basis: Mapped church/Q16412871 outline and25m mapped height; nave/vestry and baptistry split estimated from architect current imagery/section, not a surveyed interior.

museum.basis: Mapped U-shaped museum envelope. Lower functioning museum roof/terrace and roofless upper walls are separate; wall section profiles are original current-photo estimates, informed by architect +18.50/+19.96 levels and8.30m local zero. Do not extrude the full envelope to its38m mapper height.

clockTower.basis: Round mapped projection in museum footprint; original12–24-sided shaft and curved cone profile,38m archival museum tower height. Modern church/museum ground controls remain provisional.

curtain.basis: Preserve both mapped open polylines and their entrance gaps. Surviving wall height6–9m estimated from current appearance; no invented continuous crenellated perimeter.

defensiveTowers.basis: Separately mapped surviving defensive tower envelopes. Hollow roofless upper sections are draft current-section estimates; exact ruin profiles require site review.

pavilion.basis: Original coarse current entrance pavilion plan/section from architect imagery, located in the mapped main-castle entrance opening; source photos/technical plans are not redistributed.

controls.basis: Original current exterior: cathedral and baptistry roofs,38m clock tower, roofless upper U-castle, modern entrance and folded stairways, separately mapped ring walls/tower remains. Shared ground planeY0 is a draft attachment plane; actual city terrain and terrace contacts require review.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: Native+X east,+Z south; heading0 preserves all attributed footprints.
nativeAxes.origin: Wikidata horizontal reference inside cathedral; Y0 provisional outside-ground attachment plane. Actual common city/terrace datum unapproved.

reconstruction.scope: Current cathedral, baptismal chapel and side roofs, clock tower, open main-castle upper ruin walls, modern pavilion/stairs, mapped outer curtain and defensive tower remains
reconstruction.basis: Original deterministic exterior geometry informed by primary current references and independently attributed OSM numeric controls; no copied mesh or redistributed technical drawing
reconstruction.referenceState: Current monument/museum exterior; final facade counts, ruin profiles and terrain fit pending.
